body.x: CES 2020, the world's largest technology exhibition, was held in Las Vegas, USA, from January 7 to 10, and Seoul Metropolitan City helped 20 Seoul-based innovative companies enter the global market with the introduction of the advanced Smart City & Smart Life of Seoul.

A total of 20 innovative companies based in Seoul participated in the exhibition, running the pitching stage to present their innovative technologies and exclusive counseling space for business meetings.
Enable Wow unveiled SHOW TAP, the presentation app optimized for touch screen environment.

The product features the ability to use a variety of content within presentation pages such as images, web pages and YouTube videos interactively. The official explained that it can be used for insurance sales or restaurant menus.
Enernet unveiled EG Service, the smart fuse box that indicates electricity usage and helps save electricity.

This product notifies the electricity usage by using the smart meter equipped with the electricity usage data collection device every 15 minutes on the user’s smartphone. Through this, it can support smart usage environment such as reduction of electricity usage by notifying which devices used how much and how it can be used efficiently. Also, this solution can be used for local governments or apartment complexes by building their own servers in addition to KEPCO.
Thirdeye introduced Thirdeye JI-HO,equipped with a precise map surveying function on a plane-type drone capable ofvertical takeoff and landing.

It features a drone-based takeoff andflight in a confined space. With this, it can operate for up to 2 hours andtravel up to 120km, and use PPP-RTK GPS for precise map surveying and waterquality data mapping within a 3cm error range.
The AI sensor company DermaMirrow introduced DermaMirrow, a personalized 3D skin analysis measuring instrument.

This product features a 3D-based spectroscopic data to recommend the most suitable skincare product and the use cycle with the most important aspect of skin, which is measuring oil and moisture by the change of face shape and skin color. By linking the smart app, the data can be used not only for personal use but also for customer care in skincare shops.
Neosapience introduced TypeCast, a web-based AI voice casting service that outputs the voice of the desired actor or voice actor.

This service is a web-based virtual voice actor service developed to eliminate the cumbersome casting of voice actors during video production. Currently, it has worked with Daegu Publishing Company for audiobook production and reproduced the voice of Kim Gu for MBC Documentary. Recently, it also added a feature that reads comments in the desired voices in Afreeca TV live cast.

With Smart City & Smart Life as the main theme, Seoul Metropolitan City is planning to build Digital Citizen Mayor Room that shows 16 million administrative data in traffic, fire prevention, and environment of Seoul in real time, and thus boosting exports with the data-based administrative system.
